title: Matrix cube proof address
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $x$ be a vector of length $n^2$ over the field with two elements. This map sends $x$ to the right summand of the disjoint union of a set of size $n$ and a proof-address set of size $2^n+2^{n^2}$, at the position given by the canonical binary-cube index of $x$ in the block of size $2^{n^2}$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a vector of length $n^2$ over the field with two elements
